feeds.title: My Jewish Learning Blog
feeds.description: My Jewish Learning is all about empowering Jewish discovery for anyone interested in learning more. They offer thousands of articles, videos, and other resources to help you navigate all aspects of Judaism and Jewish life. Their mission is to educate others on all things Jewish.

feeds.title: Jewish Telegraphic Agency
feeds.description: JTA is the definitive, trusted global source of breaking news, investigative reporting, in-depth analysis, opinion and features on current events and issues of interest to the Jewish people.

feeds.title: American Jewish World Service Blog
feeds.description: American Jewish World Service is the first and only Jewish organization dedicated solely to ending poverty and promoting human rights in the developing world. Inspired by the Jewish commitment to justice, AJWS works to realize human rights and end poverty in the developing world. Today, AJWS is one of the top human rights funders in the world.

feeds.title: Jewish Journal
feeds.description: Get all the recent post on Religious and Reform from Jewish Journal. We regularly offers live webcasts of community events and original video. Our mission is to provide resh news to the Jewish community of Los Angeles.

feeds.title: Jewish Currents
feeds.description: Jewish Currents is a progressive, secular Jewish magazine that has been a proud voice for labor, civil rights and the promotion of Yiddish culture. Founded in 1946 as Jewish Life, the magazine was reorganized and re-launched in 1958 as Jewish Currents, with Morris U. Schappes (1907-2004) as its editor, a post he held for four decades.

feeds.title: The Jewish Press Blog
feeds.description: JewishPress.com brings you the cutting edge of jewish news, Israel, and the World. And our print edition is the largest independent Jewish weekly in America.

feeds.title: Smashing the Glass
feeds.description: Smashing the Glass is a Jewish wedding blog founded in 2013 by Karen Cinnamon. The blog has a collection of blog posts covering topics such as Jewish wedding traditions, real wedding features, and Jewish wedding vendors. They aim to bring couples who are keen to make their wedding stand out from the cookie-cutter crowd, a wealth of ideas through creative and innovative content, the best 'real Jewish wedding' eye candy and access to the most desirable.

feeds.title: Washington Jewish Week
feeds.description: Washington Jewish Week is the Jewish newspaper of record in the nation's capital since 1930. WJW strives, in its award-winning coverage in print and online, to be an indispensable source of news about politics, religion, international affairs, science and health and the arts, all while working to build and strengthen Jewish community.

feeds.title: Jewish Federation Los Angeles Blog
feeds.description: The Jewish Federation of Greater Los Angeles addresses the greatest challenges of Jewish life locally and globally. In today's complicated world, we help the most vulnerable and ensure the Jewish future for generations to come. Our mission is to convenes and leads the community and leverages its resources to assure the continuity of the Jewish people, support a secure State of Israel, care for Jews in need here and abroad, and mobilize on issues of concern to the local community, all with our local, national, and international partners.

feeds.title: Think for yourself
feeds.description: Rivka Levy - Orthodox Jewish blogger in Israel, who can tell you about 'Jewish hat name', and a whole bunch of other things, too.

feeds.title: Lilith Magazine
feeds.description: Lilith Magazine charts Jewish women's lives with exuberance, rigor, affection, subversion and style. The magazine features award-winning investigative reports, new rituals and celebrations, first-person accounts both contemporary and historical, entertainment reviews, fiction and poetry, art and photography.

feeds.title: Life in Israel
feeds.description: My thoughts on life. Life in Israel, Judaism, life in general and pretty much anything I feel like writing about.

feeds.title: Jewish Humor Central
feeds.description: Jewish Humor Central is a daily publication to start your day with news of the Jewish world that's likely to produce a knowing smile and some Yiddishe nachas. It's also a collection of sources of Jewish humor anything that brings a grin, chuckle, laugh, guffaw, or just a warm feeling to readers.

feeds.title: Jewschool
feeds.description: Jewschool is an iconic and iconoclastic progressive Jewish news and opinion weblog that has been publishing since 2002. Our mission is to connect and broadcast grassroots activists and thinkers dissatisfied with the status quo.

feeds.title: Gather the Jews
feeds.description: Gather the Jews connects 20s & 30s to Jewish DC by providing up-to-date info about all of the city's Jewish social, religious, and learning opportunities, connecting Jews to organizations, organizations to Jews, and Jews to Jews.

feeds.title: Jewish Federation of Cleveland Blog
feeds.description: The first and main place for the Jewish community of Cleveland, in Cleveland and around the world. Our Federation is a 110 year old community cornerstone that aspires to leave no community member behind. The Jewish Fed of Cle helps address the needs of the local & global Jewish & non-Jewish community.

feeds.title: Rationalist Judaism
feeds.description: Thisblog is an exploration into the rationalist approach to Judaism that was most famously presented by Maimonides. It will also explore contemporary rationalist approaches, as well as being a forum for various other notes.

feeds.title: Jewish Renaissance Blog
feeds.description: Jewish Renaissance is a quarterly magazine which presents Jewish culture in a radically new lively, colourful and accessible way.

feeds.title: Jewish Community Relations Council of Greater Boston
feeds.description: JCRC's purpose is to define and advance the values, interests and priorities of the organized Jewish community of Greater Boston in the public square.

feeds.title: Sew Jewish
feeds.description: Sewing patterns and kits for Judaica and Jewish-themed projects like tallits and wedding chuppahs. With video tutorials and other resources to help you make Judaica you'll love using. Our mission is to help you sew Judaica and Jewish-themed projects you'll love to have in your life.

feeds.title: Breaking Matzo
feeds.description: Breaking Matzo has recipes, fun projects and informative articles to make your Jewish home holidays more magical, meaningful and memorable

feeds.title: Ovation Communities News
feeds.description: Founded in 1906, Ovation Communities is a Jewish faith-based organization, and offers a full continuum of senior living and care options, from independent apartments to rehabilitation and skilled nursing services. Ovation Communities welcomes residents of all faiths.

feeds.title: Unorthodox-Jew
feeds.description: Be ashamed to die until you have won some victory for humanity Blog by Paul Mendlowitz.

feeds.title: This Day... In Jewish History
feeds.description: A collection of Jewish history and current Jewish events, in date format, updated daily in this Jewish history blog.

feeds.title: Centre for Jewish Studies Blog
feeds.description: The Centre acts as a focus for Jewish Studies at the University of Manchester and also as the hub for the Northern UK Jewish Studies Partnership. It is home to a number of outstanding academics in the fields of Bible, Dead Sea Scrolls, rabbinic Judaism, Jewish Thought, Holocaust Studies, ancient, medieval and modern Jewish History, Film Studies, Jewish/Non-Jewish Relations, and Israel Studies.

feeds.title: United Hebrew Congregation Terre Haute
feeds.description: United Hebrew Congregation is committed to maintaining the Jewish presence in the Wabash Valley by providing religious, spiritual, educational and social programming. We strive to broaden and strengthen our connections with all members of the Jewishcommunity. We value our historical role as an integral part of the wider Wabash Valley.community and endeavor to contribute to its welfare.

feeds.title: Humans of Judaism
feeds.description: Hashem chose the Jewish people because of the inner spark of spirituality that resides in every Jewish soul. Every Jew has an obligation to fan that spark and nourish it through mitzvos and good deeds. My mission is to capture the Human side of the Jewish community, sharing stories one person at a time.

feeds.title: The Jewish Writing Project
feeds.description: Bruce Black created The Jewish Writing project to encourage Jews of all backgrounds to explore what it means to be Jewish through the process of writing and now serves as editor of the project's ongoing submissions. So far more than 90 contributors from across the country, as well as England and Israel, have shared stories, memoirs, poems, and essays on different subjects.

feeds.title: Yael Shahar
feeds.description: Yael Shahar's musings on Jewish history and peoplehood, with forays into philosophy, politics, and matters of momentary import.

feeds.title: Mirta Ines Trupp ~ Author Blog
feeds.description: My fascination with Jewish history and genealogy, coupled with an obsession for historical period drama, has inspired me to create these unique and enlightening novels. I have been a guest speaker for book clubs, sisterhood events, genealogy societies, and philanthropic organizations. Sharing Jewish Historical Fiction has become my passion.

feeds.title: BECOMING JEWISH Blog
feeds.description: With over 30 years of experience in Jewish education, Rabbi Samuel provides a wealth of knowledge and resources to guide readers through the conversion journey. From exploring the basics of Jewish belief to navigating the complexities of halakha, BECOMING JEWISH Blog is an excellent source of information for those interested in converting to Judaism.

feeds.title: JMORE
feeds.description: Jmore Baltimore Jewish Living, is Baltimore and Howard County's destination for Jewish lifestyle, news, restaurants, events, religion, and information. Our mission is to build a viable media company to inform, educate, and engage the local Jewish community, institutions, and causes.

feeds.title: Mosaic Magazine
feeds.description: The main feature in Mosaic is a full-length monthly essay on an issue or theme of pressing significance for Jews, Judaism, or the Jewish state. To enrich discussion of each essay, invited experts offer responses to the author's contentions and conclusions, followed, at the end of the month, by the author's reply.

feeds.title: Ami Magazine
feeds.description: Ami Magazine, a weekly publication distributed worldwide, sets a new standard in Jewish media. Ami Magazine offers readers investigative and intriguing features as well as inviting, and professional columns.

feeds.title: Mishpacha Magazine
feeds.description: Mishpacha leads the conversation for over half a million Orthodox Jewish readers around the globe weekly. Aiming to facilitate the exchange of ideas and values between the varying streams within the Orthodox Jewish world. Our journalism and design standards quickly set the status quo.

feeds.title: Moment Magazine
feeds.description: Moment Magazine covers Jewish politics, religion, and culture. The moment provides a unique lens on the issues that trouble, concern, and inspire American Jews. It is a fiercely independent magazine that provides North American Jews with award-winning, in-depth reporting.

feeds.title: Hey Alma
feeds.description: Hey Alma is a Jewish feminist publication bringing you a diversity of voices. Always full of chutzpah, always talking about Jewish celebrities. We're here to talk about pop culture, politics, news, identity, dating, holidays, and more all from a Jewish lens.

feeds.title: The Jewish Chronicles
feeds.description: News coverage ranges from investigations to reports of communal activities, with context provided by leading commentators and cultural figures. The Jewish Chronicle's features and lifestyle cover everything from arts and food to fashion and travel. The world's oldest and most influential Jewish newspaper.

feeds.title: Jewish Exponent
feeds.description: The Jewish Exponent is the second-oldest continuously published Jewish newspaper in the United States, it has evolved from its roots as a voice for prominent businessmen to a multimedia platform for delivering Jewish news and information and stimulating community dialogue. All the news and information of how it feels and means to be Jewish in Philadelphia.

feeds.title: Baltimore Jewish Times
feeds.description: Baltimore Jewish Times is a powerhouse of Jewish journalism, earning national and international acclaim, today the JT is a cornerstone of the Jewish community, delivering in print and on jewishtimes.com a wealth of important local, national and international news and opinion, plus entertaining features and profiles and convenient, useful advertising content.

feeds.title: Jewish Museum London Blog
feeds.description: Find out the latest news, blog posts, and podcasts and hear from members of staff, volunteers, and interns here at the Jewish Museum. Jewish Museum London tells the story of the history and heritage of Jewish people in Britain through universal themes of migration, family, faith, and culture.

feeds.title: Tradition Online
feeds.description: Tradition is the Journal of Orthodox Jewish thought published quarterly by the Rabbinical Council of America since 1958. We welcome contributions from women and men that offer new insights and treatments of the array of topics that fit within that field, broadly defined.

feeds.title: jGirls+ Magazine
feeds.description: jGirls+ Magazine is an online magazine & community by and of self-identifying Jewish female and nonbinary teens 13-19. A global community for Jewish female and nonbinary teens to voice their realities, engage with new ideas, and lift each other as they lead social change.

feeds.title: JLife Magazine
feeds.description: JLife Magazine is a community magazine for the people of Leeds and Manchester. Created for the Jewish community, it now has a wider outreach and regularly features news, events, and more for the local community & businesses.

feeds.title: The Jewish Weekly
feeds.description: The Jewish Weekly is Britain's largest circulated Jewish newspaper. Here you can find articles on Gantz's warning of global extremism and terrorism, the Annual Shluchim conference, the Poland teen trip with Tribe, and many more!

feeds.title: Jew in the City Blog
feeds.description: Jew in the City has quickly grown to be a leading voice in this generation. It is the only nonprofit dedicated to changing negative perceptions about religious Jews and making engaging and meaningful Orthodox Judaism known and accessible. Find the latest news on all things related to Jews & our community.

feeds.title: Reform Judaism Blog
feeds.description: Reform Judaism is the largest Jewish movement in North America - & we're your resource for Reform Jews, spiritual seekers, & anyone who wants to learn more. Read all the news and information on the war, refugees, and more!

feeds.title: New Voices
feeds.description: Published by the Jewish Student Press Service, New Voices Magazine is America's only national magazine written and published by and for Jewish college students. We uncover the issues and controversies in the Jewish community that matter to us. We are a proving ground for this generation of Jewish journalists and leaders.

feeds.title: Jewish Ledger
feeds.description: For 90 years the Jewish Ledger has served CT by providing breaking news, insightful editorials, and provocative pictures. It is Connecticut's only weekly Jewish newspaper. The Hartford newspaper also has a monthly edition serving the Greater Hartford and western Massachusetts area.

feeds.title: The Jewish Standard Magazine
feeds.description: The Jewish Standard Magazine, with editions across Eastern Canada, has been publishing since 1929. We produce a well respected periodical, which includes timely news about the State of Israel and the local Jewish communities served.

feeds.title: Hadassah Magazine
feeds.description: Hadassah Magazine is published bimonthly covering politics, news, and culture, joining prize-winning journalism with our readers' diverse interests. Focusing on Jewish women, health, Israel, and culture, including food, travel, and books.

feeds.title: The Canadian Jewish News
feeds.description: Daily breaking news, podcasts, newsletters and events that matter to the Canadian Jewish community. The Canadian Jewish News is a not-for-profit, award-winning media organization producing content that matters to the diverse community of Jews in Canada, through articles, podcasts and events.

feeds.title: Jewish News
feeds.description: Jewish News is a former Press Gazette free newspaper of the year and the only newspaper to exclusively serve the Jewish communities of Greater London. It is at the heart of this thriving, educated, and affluent community, providing a weekly mix of local, national, and international Jewish news, features, sport, and entertainment.

feeds.title: Atlanta Jewish Times
feeds.description: Atlanta Jewish Times is a local newspaper connecting the Southeastern Jewish community. The mission of the Atlanta Jewish Times is to create a sense of community throughout the geographically dispersed Jewish people of greater Atlanta. It accomplishes its mission through the timely dissemination of local news and important national Jewish and Israeli interests.

feeds.title: The Jewish World News
feeds.description: Your gateway to Jewish life! Albany's only Jewish newspaper, sharing news stories relevant to you! The Jewish World publishes news of events for the Capital District Jewish community, and carries stories on events affecting Jewish people all over the world.

feeds.title: American Jewish World News
feeds.description: Since 1912, the AJW has served as an important news resource for the Jewish community throughout Minnesota. The Jewish World unites the main Jewish communities in St. Paul and Minneapolis, as well as those in Duluth, Rochester, and smaller cities, and bridges the divides between the various Jewish religious streams.

feeds.title: Heritage Florida Jewish News
feeds.description: Central Florida's Independent Jewish Voice. The Heritage was founded to help to unify a scattered community by focusing on Jewish issues. It is published independently of any outside agency and depends solely on subscribers and advertisers for support.

feeds.title: Jewish News
feeds.description: Jewish News connects the Tidewater Jewish community with news of Jewish interest from local, national, and global spheres. We offer news on topics like nearly half of U.S. adults believe America should be a 'Christian nation', it's time to start thinking about end-of-year planning, and more!

feeds.title: Jewish Business News
feeds.description: Jewish Business News is one of the best sources for Israeli and Jewish businesses worldwide in the fields of innovation, startups, technologies, and much more! It focuses on business, entrepreneurship, technology, investing, leadership, and lifestyle.

feeds.title: San Antonio Jewish Journal
feeds.description: Find all the news for the San Antonio Jewish Community. The Jewish Journal is powered by the Jewish Federation of San Antonio. It works to strengthen Jewish communities here, everywhere, always.

feeds.title: Jstyle Magazine
feeds.description: Jstyle shares Jewish entertainment, fashion, lifestyle, and news! A style magazine serving Northeast Ohio's Jewish community and Greater Cleveland. Affluent women and men as well as influential young professionals regularly pick up Jstyle to read the latest on modern living, from stylish fall fashion and can't-miss events around the region to Greater Cleveland's dining hot spots and latest décor trends.

feeds.title: Boulder Jewish News
feeds.description: All about arts, culture, events, lifestyles, holidays, synagogues, education, and more! Boulder's Jewish community has long deserved such a community-wide forum and source of information and opinion. BJN provides that space here, in true Boulder fashion exclusively online at the Boulder Jewish News.

feeds.title: Charlotte Jewish News
feeds.description: The Charlotte Jewish News is a monthly (except July) publication dedicated to informing, representing, and engaging the Greater Charlotte Jewish community. The CJN reports on news and upcoming events of the local Jewish agencies, accomplishments of the members of the local Jewish community, and stories about Jewish holidays and events in Charlotte, the U.S., and Israel.

feeds.title: Alberta Jewish News
feeds.description: Alberta Jewish News is a tabloid newspaper that has been published since 1990 as the voice of the Jewish Communities in Edmonton, Calgary, and Alberta. The newspaper is mailed free of charge to all members of the community. It is also available at several distribution points within the city including synagogues and schools.

feeds.title: JLife
feeds.description: JLife Magazine started publishing back in 2005. The goal at JLife OC is to display the variety and vitality of Jewish Orange County. It is an attempt to do so by covering all demographics of our diverse community.

feeds.title: Nefesh B'Nefesh
feeds.description: The core mission of NBN is to revitalize Aliyah and to substantially increase the number of future Olim by removing the financial, professional and logistical obstacles that prevent many individuals from actualizing their dreams.

feeds.title: Jewlicious
feeds.description: Jewlicious is a Jewish, non-denominational organization that allows young Jews to make informed decisions about what role Judaism should have in the evolution of their personal identities. Jewlicious is a grass-roots community that celebrates, contemplates and investigates questions of Jewish identity.

feeds.title: Be'chol Lashon
feeds.description: Be'chol Lashon (Hebrew for 'in every language') strengthens Jewish identity by raising awareness about the ethnic, racial, and cultural diversity of Jewish identity and experience. We bring the historic Jewish commitment to civil rights and racial justice forward into the 21st century. Embracing the historical diversity of the Jewish people and, more importantly, the growing diversity of the community today is the most important step toward securing relevancy in an exciting American future.

feeds.title: Jewish World Watch Blog
feeds.description: Jewish World Watch fights genocide and mass atrocities where they are occurring today. Our mission is to mobilize communities to combat genocide and other egregious violations of human rights around the world.

feeds.title: DOVBEAR
feeds.description: A leading Jewish blog with posts on almost every topic. Orthodoxy and liberalism usually don't mix, Dov Bear makes an exception.

feeds.title: Out of the Ortho Box
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Ruchi Koval. I'm an Orthodox Jewish woman. Married, kids. This blog is about promoting Jewish unity among people of all beliefs via mutual respect and education.

feeds.title: Jewish Interest Stories by Jill Culiner Blog
feeds.description: In this blog, you will find Small forgotten stories from Jewish history.

feeds.title: Pure Judaism יהדות טהורה Blog
feeds.description: The Way Judaism Was Meant To Be. Rabbinic Judaism is not Biblical Judaism. My mission is to purify Rabbinic Judaism in order to unify all Jews and bring the Redemption and Messiah.

feeds.title: Jewish Scene Magazine
feeds.description: Jewish Scene is a lifestyle Magazine connecting Jewish communities. With every issue, more than 25,000 print and 23,000 online readers (and growing) learn about interesting people, places, and Jewish events throughout the United States and Israel.

feeds.title: Jewish Lives Blog
feeds.description: Jewish Lives is a prizewinning series of biography designed to explore the many facets of Jewish identity. Individual volumes illuminate the imprint of Jewish figures upon literature, religion, philosophy, politics, cultural and economic life, and the arts and sciences. Read our blog to read all the stories.

feeds.title: Jewish Views
feeds.description: Jewish Views (JV) is a digital media platform celebrating the commonality and diversity of Jewish communities around the globe. JV explores what connects us, addresses the impact of the world around us, looks at how we impact the world, and highlights Das Pintele Yid- The Jewish Spark: in each of us.

feeds.title: Messianic Times
feeds.description: The Messianic Times has grown to become the leading international Messianic Jewish newspaper since it burst onto the scene in 1990. Always seeks to provide accurate, authoritative, and current information to unite the international Messianic Jewish community, teach Christians the Jewish roots of their faith and proclaim that Yeshua is the Jewish Messiah.

feeds.title: Jewish Camp » News & Updates
feeds.description: The Foundation for Jewish Camp (FJC) supports and advocates for over 150 nonprofit Jewish overnight camps of all denominations across North America. Our mission unifies and galvanizes the field of Jewish overnight camp and significantly increases the number of children participating in transformative summers at Jewish camp, assuring a vibrant North American Jewish community.

feeds.title: The Forward
feeds.description: The Forward, an independent, high-profile weekly newspaper, is a fearless and indispensable source of news and opinion on Jewish affairs.

feeds.title: Jewish Cincinnati News
feeds.description: The Jewish Federation of Cincinnati develops and connects leaders, contributors, organizations and ideas to build an inclusive Jewish community that cares for people in need, supports Israel and assures a vibrant Jewish future.

feeds.title: The Canadian Jewish News
feeds.description: Canada's largest weekly Jewish newspaper. It is an independent community newspaper. To be a forum for diverse points of view on subjects of interest and relevance to the Jewish community, in Canada, Israel and throughout the world.

feeds.title: Oregon Jewish Life
feeds.description: Oregon Jewish Life is a monthly, full-color Jewish lifestyle magazine that highlights the vitality, diversity, and accomplishments of the Jewish community. Find all the news, tips, food precipices, business news, information, and more!

feeds.title: Crescent City Jewish News
feeds.description: The Crescent City Jewish News (CCJN) is the result of the passion of longtime Jewish journalist and editor Alan Smason. Our mission is to provide continuous coverage of news that will inform, support, and promote the Greater New Orleans Jewish community and all extended families located throughout the United States, Israel, and the world.

feeds.title: Jewish Voice for Peace
feeds.description: JVP is a national member-driven organization dedicated to a U.S. foreign policy based on peace, human rights, and international law. Jewish Voice for Peace members are inspired by Jewish tradition to work together for peace, social justice, equality, human rights, respect for international law, and a U.S. foreign policy based on these ideals.

feeds.title: Sydney Jewish Museum Blog
feeds.description: The Sydney Jewish Museum challenges perceptions of democracy, morality, social justice and human rights and places the Holocaust in an historical and contemporary context.

feeds.title: Inner Judaism
feeds.description: Writings about Jewish Community, Education and Outreach. As a Jewish education professional, I work with organizations to help them identify and train their future leaders, conduct effective outreach activities, and work on getting the resources they need to carry out a plan of growth.

feeds.title: Jewcy
feeds.description: Jewcy is a platform for ideas that matter to young Jews today. It provides the latest news and information on categories like news, art & culture, sec & love, religion & beliefs, Jewish food, and more!

feeds.title: The Detroit Jewish News
feeds.description: The Detroit Jewish News is a pro-Zionist newspaper that has been serving Metro Detroit's Jewish community since 1942. It is a trusted source for news, stories and opinions that affect the Metro Detroit Jewish community and beyond.

feeds.title: Arizona Jewish Life
feeds.description: Arizona Jewish Life is working towards amplifying the voices of all Jews: Black LGBTQ Observant Converted & Cultural Jews, non-Jews & those who have never met a Jew.

feeds.title: Southern Jewish Life Magazine
feeds.description: Southern Jewish Life is the magazine serving the Jewish communities of Alabama, Louisiana, Mississippi, and northwest Florida. We are a unique magazine for a unique community. Our commitment includes mailing to every Jewish household in the region, without a subscription fee.

feeds.title: Jewish News Syndicate
feeds.description: Jewish News Syndicate (JNS) is the fastest-growing news agency covering Israel and the Jewish world. We provide briefs, news, features, opinions, and analysis to as many as 100 print newspapers and digital publications on a daily basis.

feeds.title: J. The Jewish News of Northern California
feeds.description: Today, The Jewish News of Northern California is a nonprofit publication with a website that reaches more than a million people each year and a biweekly print edition that serves nearly 20,000 homes throughout Northern California.

feeds.title: Intermountain Jewish News
feeds.description: The Intermountain Jewish News is a weekly independent newspaper founded in 1913, covering the Jewish communities of the Front Range. The IJN has garnered many first-place awards in news writing, features, profiles, arts and criticism, editorial writing, special sections, and graphic design.
